publisher: Central Statistics Office (Ireland), from ESB Networks
title: Metered Electricity Consumption by tariff group and year (MEC05)
used_for: The aggregate cross-check, and the one that matches Cobh's own tariff group: 'Urban Residential' rather than a national all-dwellings mean. Cobh is a town, and urban residential consumption differs from rural (no oil-fired rural pattern, smaller dwellings). Reference and not calibration, because it cannot be made per-dwelling: the CSO publishes no meter COUNT by tariff group, so the 5,668 GWh has no denominator. It fixes the urban-to-rural RATIO (5,668 to 3,095 GWh) and nothing more.
